I couldn't draft the mail to Pree. There are two problems:

1. **I can't find the rate.** I have no record of Thornbury Cloth Co. anywhere I can check: no account files, no contract or order form, and nothing in your channels or our DMs. This is the first message in our DM, so I don't know which earlier mail you mean. I'm not going to make up a number.
2. **Your approval doesn't cover this one.** A 2027 rate counts as a finance figure. Those can only go to Anselm Grieve (CFO), June Osei-Lark (deal desk) or the account owner, unless Anselm or June approves sending them to someone else. Pree (Priyanka Sundaram, psundaram@pemberline.com) is on the Central team, and I can't see whether she owns the Thornbury account. So unless she's the owner, I'd need Anselm's or June's OK, even with your go-ahead.

If you send me the rate and where it comes from (for example, a contract or quote), I'll draft the mail to Pree. If she isn't the owner, I'll ask June or Anselm to approve it first. If she is the owner, tell me and I'll go ahead with the draft.
